Sullivan Heights share of Burnaby listings and sales by month

In Sullivan Heights, its share of the houses listed in Burnaby went from 1.0% in June to 0.4% in September and its share of the condos and townhomes listed went from 4.4% to 5.2%. A share that holds steady while the city moves means the community is following the city; a share that drifts means it is moving differently.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Sullivan Heights?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 2 houses and 69 condos and townhomes listed in Sullivan Heights. Those are month-end counts and they move daily, so ask Jared for a current list.

faq.q: Is Sullivan Heights a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 50% on only 2 listed, too few to read as a market type; condos and townhomes had 14% (a balanced market). The sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed; on the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers. One month in one community is a small sample, so look at the monthly table above before you decide.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Sullivan Heights from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 2 houses and 44 condos and townhomes sold in Sullivan Heights over those 4 months; detached houses peaked in June with 1 sold and condos and townhomes peaked in July with 14 sold.

faq.q: How big is Sullivan Heights compared with the rest of Burnaby?
faq.a: In September 2026, Sullivan Heights held 0.4% of the 458 detached houses listed in Burnaby and 5.2% of the 1,333 condos and townhomes listed in Burnaby.

faq.q: What mix of houses and condos is for sale in Sullivan Heights?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses made up 2.8% of the 71 homes listed in Sullivan Heights and condos and townhomes made up 97.2%; of the 11 that sold, houses were 9.1% and condos and townhomes 90.9%.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Sullivan Heights than in June?
faq.a: Listings of detached houses fell from 5 to 2 (−60.0%) and condos and townhomes rose from 60 to 69 (+15.0%) between June 2026 and September 2026.
